scenarios.observes: Observe UTC leap-year fractional day, both signed drag derivatives, implied exponents, angular units, mean motion and repeated epoch.
Read all ten components on contrasting low, high and resonant fictional satellites in repeated parser calls.
The same two-digit epoch year maps on opposite sides of the firstYear cutoff.
Observe equal full outputs with intact, omitted and deliberately different checksum digits; compare trailing blanks too.
N0067 accepts both endpoints of the [0,20] rev/day parser range; zero is a parser-only observation.
Observe zero and 180 degree inclinations and angular conversion.
Trailing blank padding keeps both short records addressable before the length error.
The two record catalog numbers must match before the time conversion.
One nonnumeric mean anomaly gives a scientific diagnostic at the named field.
A 360-degree ascending node is outside the parser range.
A mean motion above 20 revolutions/day signals the canonical parser error.
A parsed valid pair still needs a leap second table.
Observe valid values before and after a captured bad ID, then clear and restore the LSK.

routines.semantics: Parse the supplied pair to TDB seconds after J2000 and ten model elements, preserving the signed exponents, angle/rate conversions and repeated epoch. The fractional UTC day uses the loaded leap-seconds kernel and firstYear selects the two-digit century.
routines.edgeAssessment: 68/69 nonblank columns, omitted or changed checksum, trailing blanks, repeated firstYear boundaries, zero/180-degree inclinations, zero/20 rev/day parser range. Matching vehicle ID precedes length checks.
routines.errorAssessment: BADTLE for mismatched IDs, invalid columns, angle/range and malformed numeric field; NOLEAPSECONDS for a valid pair without the LSK. Wrapper validation separately covers unrepresentable text or calendar bounds, preserving earlier canonical errors.

findings.summary: The parser compares the first six ID columns before checking the native row length and later converts calendar fields to signed day counts.
findings.repair: Keep at least seven readable ASCII bytes per row and let actual CSPICE handle ordinary malformed records. For out-of-range calendar arithmetic, consult pinned field parsing and preserve the true earlier status at a safely representable calendar argument.

scenarios.observes: Observe all six TEME position and velocity values at epoch and at independent positive and negative offsets.
Cross multiple positive and negative half-day integration steps on a synchronous relay orbit.
Exercise the eccentric half-day resonance with asymmetric orientation and several evaluation times.
Compare a less-than-six-revolutions-per-day nonresonant orbit at epoch and after multiple periods.
Reinitialize alternating model regimes in one client and repeat the first state.
Contrast J2 and ER effects separately, then observe N0067 fixed atmospheric parameters with alternate QO, SO and AE entries.
EVSGP4 initializes with TDB to JDUTC conversion even for direct numeric elements.
Perigee inside the Earth yields a genuine SUBORBITAL error.
A negative mean eccentricity past the pinned tolerance yields BADMECCENTRICITY.
Recover a valid nominal state and independently recompute after errors and LSK restoration.

routines.semantics: Initialize from the complete Earth constants and elements at the UTC Julian date corresponding to the elements TDB epoch, then return all six TEME state components (km and km/s) at the requested TDB epoch. Initialization is repeated even after a different prior orbit.
routines.edgeAssessment: Near-Earth, synchronous, eccentric half-day and nonresonant deep-space orbits, forward/backward evaluation, repeated epoch, switching orbit regimes, distinct geophysical constants and LSK unload/reload.
routines.errorAssessment: Original SUBORBITAL, BADMECCENTRICITY and NOLEAPSECONDS diagnostics compare on both backends. Computational and signed-calendar guards are tested separately from actual CSPICE diagnostics.

findings.summary: The SpiceyPy 6.0.3 EVSGP4 wrapper omits the normal error decorator and can return its buffer even though N0067 set an error.
findings.repair: Immediately check independent SPICE status after the original public call before interpreting the six outputs; retain missing kernel, suborbital and eccentricity error evidence and recovery.

findings.summary: The translated initialization uses signed calendar intermediates and the resonant deep-space integrator takes one step per 720 minutes.
findings.repair: Bound the element epoch, query the pinned corrected mean motion only on large intervals and guard only the two source-defined resonances. Preserve real initialization error priority. The unaffected nonresonant controls above the work boundary run the real full propagator on both runtimes.
